T-001.Title: Failing-first closure pins: the eager-deactivation pin recorded red on the pre-change tree, companion neighborhood pins, existing five pins guarded green

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Tests only – no product file is written in this task. Add four named pins to tests/renderer/store/live-stream-ownership.test.js shaped after the suite's existing fixture/open/patch helpers, and record their receipts against the pre-change tree BEFORE any editor.js edit, red exactly as described; receipts are preserved as pre-change evidence in the change record and never relabeled post-fix. (a) force_close_tab_deactivates_a_live_binding_eagerly – fixture, OPEN_LIVE_DOCUMENT(open()), then FORCE_CLOSE_TAB of the live tab; immediately after the close returns, the pin asserts store.liveDocument.active is false with no PATCH in between. On the pre-change tree this is RED: FORCE_CLOSE_TAB (:1365-1449) never consults this.liveDocument, so the binding stays active pointing at the dead tabId until the lazy heal at :1730 – exactly the spec's VerificationIntent red receipt (the binding stays active after FORCE_CLOSE_TAB until a PATCH arrives). (b) commit_document_window_deactivates_the_live_binding – OPEN_LIVE_DOCUMENT(open()), then _commitDocumentWindow('mt_app_quit') through the suite's established global @tauri-apps/api/core invoke mock (tests/renderer/setup.ts; the fixture keeps _opensInFlight at zero), asserting store.liveDocument.active is false after the commit resolves; RED on the pre-change tree, where _commitDocumentWindow (:639-652) raises only documentWindowClosing and the binding survives.

(c) force_close_tab_of_an_unrelated_tab_keeps_the_live_binding – OPEN_LIVE_DOCUMENT(open()) with the local fixture tab still open, FORCE_CLOSE_TAB of the unrelated local tab, and the live binding is untouched (still active, its tab intact, PATCH still returns true); GREEN today and green after – the pin exists so the T-003 eager deactivation cannot overreach into sibling-tab closes. (d) close_live_document_keeps_its_documented_shape – OPEN_LIVE_DOCUMENT(open()), CLOSE_LIVE_DOCUMENT of the same identity returns true, binding.active is false, the streamed tab remains in store.tabs with requiresExplicitSave true, and a following PATCH returns false; GREEN today and green after – the pin records the decided stream-end vocabulary (binding only, the tab remains) that T-005 writes into the module contract.

The suite's existing five pins stay in place verbatim and green – in particular the lazy-heal pin "refuses closed-tab patches and recreates only on a later explicit open" (:60-72) and the CLOSE_LIVE_DOCUMENT pins at :84/:88; no existing assertion is weakened, skipped or relabeled; no new dependency, no network, no sleeps. Expected run shape on the pre-change tree: (a) and (b) fail, (c) and (d) and the five existing pins pass – that mixed receipt IS the recorded evidence.
